modeBadge.pure_transfer.label: Pure Transfer
modeBadge.pure_transfer.explanation: Forecast built from scaled proxy posterior + recipient anchors. No compromises — this is the primary Launch Planner scenario.
modeBadge.transfer_bias.label: Transfer + Bias Check
modeBadge.transfer_bias.explanation: Pure Transfer plus observed-vs-predicted check on available recipient data points. A warning is raised if bias exceeds 30%.
modeBadge.ols_priors.label: OLS + Priors (simplified)
modeBadge.ols_priors.explanation: Current version (v0.1.0-rc2) uses Pure Transfer with tighter similarity inflation. Full OLS regression with proxy posterior priors ships in v0.1.1. CI bands are conservative — the forecast is usable.
modeBadge.bayesian_priors.label: Bayesian + Priors (simplified)
modeBadge.bayesian_priors.explanation: Current version (v0.1.0-rc2) uses Pure Transfer. Full Bayesian regression with informative priors ships in v0.1.1. The forecast is reliable, but not maximally precise for a large recipient dataset.
onboarding.tutorial.slide1.title: Forecasting a new brand launch
onboarding.tutorial.slide1.body: Aurora Launch Planner builds a sales forecast for a brand with no data yet, using a similar brand as a proxy.
onboarding.tutorial.slide2.title: Loading data
onboarding.tutorial.slide2.body: We accept XLSX from Econometrica, .aurora bundles from Data Studio, or connections to enterprise data sources.
onboarding.tutorial.slide3.title: Forecast and confidence
onboarding.tutorial.slide3.body: The algorithm produces a point forecast plus a credible interval. The Trust score summarises reliability as a single number (0–100).
onboarding.tutorial.slide4.title: Sensitivity scenarios
onboarding.tutorial.slide4.body: One click gives three scenarios: pessimistic, base, optimistic. Expert mode exposes 6 sensitivity parameters.
onboarding.tutorial.slide5.title: Methodology certificate
onboarding.tutorial.slide5.body: Every forecast is signed with Ed25519. Verify independently at verify.auroraai.pro — the algorithm is public.
